text: Porta is a table cipher in which every letter of the first half of the alphabet becomes one of the second half, and the other way round, whatever the key.
So each known letter and the letter carved over it must sit in opposite halves. Tried for 248 letter orders; the best still has 7 places where they share a half.
One shared half is enough to rule an order out, so Porta is dead before any key is tried.
